name: Jun Sable
role: Owner of the Neutral Ground, the bar at Haven Station
note: Runs the only bar at Haven Station where every faction drinks together. Knows everything, and sells it.
appearance: A very tall Veshti folded behind a very low bar, polishing a glass that has never once been clean.
personality: Dry, unflappable and scrupulously fair. Neutrality isn't their principle, it's their business model.
voice: Laconic and deadpan. Answers questions with prices.
goals: Keep the bar open and the peace kept, and stay useful to everyone at once.
secrets: They're a former Concord Intelligence officer, and they know exactly what happened to the CFS Tarn.
